text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to reduce the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Cavotti Crescent, between Wilmington Avenue and Evanston Drive. The implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit on this roadway is warranted. It will promote reduced travel speed and provide a safer environment for cyclists and pedestrians.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Cavotti Crescent, between Wilmington Avenue and Evanston Drive.
